name: 張朝陽
objective: 通論，基本理論，傳輸線參數，傳輸線的數學模式，變壓器的數學模式及標么值系統，對稱成分，對稱三相故障，非對稱故障，負載潮流分析與控制，電力系統之經濟運轉，發電機之數學模式，電力系統穩定度，電壓控制系統，電力控制系統，系統保護。
schedule:
(1) 第一週至第二週:
A. Background :Electric Energy ,Fossil-Fuel Plant.Power Plant, Transmission and Distribution Systems,
B. Basic Principles: Balanced Three-Phase,Per-Phase Analysis
(2) 第三週至第五週:
A. Balanced Three-Phase Power
B. Transmission- Line Parameters: Flux Linkages, Many - Conductor Case, Conductor Bundling,Transposition, Line Capacitance,
C. Transmission- Line Modeling,Transmission Matrix
(3) 第六週至第七週: 
A. Complex Power Transmission (Short Line), Complex Power Transmission (Short Radial Line)
B. Complex Power Transmission (Long or Medium Line),
C. Power-Handling Capability of Lines
D. Transformer Modeling and The Per Unit System, Single-Phase Transformer Connections, Normal Systems
(4) 第八週: 期中考試
(5) 第九週至第十週:
A. Per Unit Three-Phase Quantities,
B. Per Unit Analysis of Normal System
C. Transmission Line And Transformers
(6) 第十一週至第十三週:
A.Generator Modeling I (Machine Viewpoint), Open-Circuit Voltage, Terminal Voltage, Power Delived By Generator
B. Generator Modeling Ⅱ (Circuit Viewpoint) : Transformation Park’s Voltage Equation, .Park’s Mechanical Equation, Synchronous Operation
(7) 第十四週至第十五週:
A. Steady-State Model, Generator Connected to Infinte Bus
B. Network Matrice: Bus Admittance Matrix,.Network Solution, Kron Reduction, Ybus Structure and Manipulation, Bus Impedance Matrix
(8) 第十六週: 期末考試
(9) 第十七週至第十八週: 彈性學習
scorePolicy: 期中考佔 30%，期末考佔 40%，演算習作及隨堂問答佔 30%。第 17-18 週不列入學期成績。
materials: Power system analysis, 2nd Edition, Arthur R.Bergen, Vijay Vittal; Prentice Hall,2000
consultation: 1. 請於諮商時間到綜合科館 313 研究室諮詢。2 請於下課時間諮詢。3. 請應用 e-mail 諮詢。4.Email: cychang@ntut.edu.tw
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
